name: Switch
description: Switches toggle the state of an item on or off. They are used for binary settings that take effect immediately.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the switch is in the selected (on) state

props.name: icons
props.description: Shows both selected and deselected icons

props.name: showOnlySelectedIcon
props.description: Shows only the selected icon, not the deselected icon

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the switch must be selected for form submission

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when selected

props.name: name
props.description: The HTML name for form submission

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the switch state changes due to user interaction

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the switch receives input

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Announce switch label and on/off state. Always provide aria-label for switches without visible labels.
accessibility.focusManagement: Receives focus in tab order. Focus ring visible on keyboard focus.

llm.intent: Provide immediate binary toggle for settings and preferences
antiPatterns: Switch without visible or accessible label
Switch for deferred actions (use checkbox in form)
Using switch in a list where checkbox is more appropriate
Multiple switches that are mutually exclusive
llm.semanticMeaning: Binary toggle for immediate effect settings
